# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_HOLD_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When a gap up fails to hold above VWAP for two consecutive 5-minute bars, it indicates weak buying interest and a high probability of mean reversion to fill the gap. This edge exists because initial gap-up momentum often lacks follow-through, especially in low-volatility regimes, leading to a reversion toward the prior day's close as liquidity absorbs the imbalance.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If SPY gaps up >0.5% versus prior close AND price fails to close above VWAP for two consecutive 5-minute bars after the gap open (both closes below VWAP), enter short at the close of the second bar below VWAP.  
**Stop:** Chart stop placed above the high of the gap bar.  
**Exit:** Initial TP1 at 1.2R; runner uses a premium-based trailing stop of 15% of ATR from the lowest price reached after entry.  
**Regime filters:** Avoid if pre-market VIX ≥18 or pre-market volume >1.5× average; skip gaps >1.5% as they often indicate strong momentum.
